model-value.desc: Model of the component (shown/hidden); use v-model

persistent.desc: Cannot dismiss by clicking outside or hitting ESC

no-esc-dismiss.desc: Cannot dismiss by hitting ESC key

no-route-dismiss.desc: Route change won't dismiss the dialog

auto-close.desc: Any click inside the dialog will close it

seamless.desc: No backdrop; user can interact with the rest of the page

full-width.desc: Dialog renders with same width as the window

full-height.desc: Dialog renders with same height as the window

position.desc: Stick dialog to a side (top, right, bottom, left)

no-refocus.desc: Don't refocus previous element when dialog hides

no-focus.desc: Don't focus dialog when it shows

no-shake.desc: Disable shake animation on dismiss attempt

allow-focus-outside.desc: Allow elements outside dialog to receive focus

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when the dialog visibility changes

show.desc: Emitted after the dialog has been shown

before-show.desc: Emitted before the dialog is shown

hide.desc: Emitted after the dialog has been hidden

before-hide.desc: Emitted before the dialog is hidden

shake.desc: Emitted when the dialog shakes to catch attention

escape-key.desc: Emitted when ESC key is pressed (if not persistent)
